description: Migrate a legacy Salesforce Care Cloud patient-intake requirement to native Health Cloud objects and personas.
prompt:
Migrate this legacy Care Cloud requirement to Health Cloud:

'A Care Support Rep creates a Patient__c record when a new caller phones in. They capture the Caller_Name__c, Caller_Phone__c, Reason_for_Call__c (picklist: New Enrollment, Refill, Adherence Question, Device Help, Adverse Event), and Referring_Physician_Name__c. On save, a Case_c is created linked to the Patient__c and routed to the appropriate queue by Reason_for_Call__c. If Reason = Adverse Event, an alert is sent to Pharmacovigilance.'

hard_blockers: Persona is a concrete Health Cloud role (e.g. Patient Services Representative), NOT 'Care Support Rep' verbatim from legacy, NOT 'Patient'
Story uses native HC objects: Account (Person Account, Patient record type) or Individual, and Case — NOT the legacy Patient__c or Case_c custom objects
Save/Submit AC includes Pattern E block for Account + Case with every field enumerated
PHI audit AC present (RULE 16) — reason: story writes patient identifying information
Field-level security / permission set spec present (Pattern C)
Technical Implementation section present after ACs
Legacy Source header present in output template — populated with 'Patient__c custom object + Case_c custom object from legacy Care Cloud instance'
Adverse-event branch is Pattern D (routing rules) with parallel Case creation, NOT a mysterious 'alert to PV'
quality_checks: Reason_for_Call_c → Case.Category picklist mapping documented in Technical Implementation, not in Pattern A ACs
'Referring Physician' modeled as HealthcareProvider lookup on Case, not a text field
Build-technology decision states declarative-first (Screen Flow + Record-Triggered Flow), rejects OmniScript as overkill
Clarification Questions table calls out data-migration scope (existing Patient__c records)

red_flags_auto_fail: Story preserves 'Care Support Rep' as the persona
Story preserves 'Patient__c' or 'Case_c' in the story body (should only appear in the Legacy Source header + Technical Implementation as a mapping note)
'As a Patient' persona for what is clearly an internal Care Cloud replacement
